description: S45 T3 (PM8): the FILTERED half of policy.changes — policyId reads one rule's trail (the (policy_id, id) index the migration installed serves exactly this read) and limit clamps at the accessor's [1,500]/default-50 contract, both ANDed on the newest-first order. The two empties stay two answers: a filter that matches nothing while the table holds rows prints NO statement (the filter's emptiness is the filter's answer — the empty-table sentence belongs to a Count-proved zero alone), and here the two rows are simply that rule's whole history: the operator added it from the CLI door, a person removed it from the socket door. The actor pair is the audit's whole point: who widened the guard, from which door.
